# Spark UI (@sparkwire)

> React component library with a "Live Wire" look: components carry current (sparks on press, flowing current on hover, a lever switch with a bulb). Accessible behaviour from React Aria, zero-runtime CSS with --spark-* variables, light/dark/system modes, works in React Server Components. Use it as an npm package (@sparkwire/core) or copy the source (npx sparkwire add <name>).

Key facts for writing code:
- Import the stylesheet once: import '@sparkwire/core/styles.css'. Set the mode with data-spark-theme="dark" | "light" | "system" on <html> or any wrapper.
- App-wide defaults and slot classes: <SparkProvider components={{ Button: { defaultProps: { variant: 'outlined' } } }} locale="hi-IN">.
- Every component takes className, and most take classNames for inner parts. State is exposed as data-* attributes (data-state, data-open, data-invalid, data-disabled) for CSS or Tailwind.
- Forms: inputs take name and work with FormData and React Hook Form. Dropdown/Combobox/Slider/DatePicker submit through hidden inputs.
- Dates are plain JS Date objects; DatePicker submits ISO YYYY-MM-DD. Locales and calendar systems (indian, islamic-umalqura, buddhist...) are supported.
- Pick a value: Dropdown (alias Select). Search then pick: Combobox. Run actions: Menu.
- Custom markup with Spark behaviour: useSwitch, useCheckbox, useSlider, useDatePicker, useSpark from '@sparkwire/core/headless'. Building blocks: ButtonBase, InputBase, Popover, ListBox, Overlay from '@sparkwire/core/base'.
- The npm scope is @sparkwire (not @spark-ui, which is a different library).

## Components
- [Button](https://phoenix-am.github.io/spark-ui/?path=/docs/actions-button--docs): Throws sparks from the press point; current runs along outlined buttons on hover. Exports: Button.
- [Spark](https://phoenix-am.github.io/spark-ui/?path=/docs/effects-spark--docs): A burst of sparks from a point; used by Button and Calendar. Exports: Spark.
- [Switch](https://phoenix-am.github.io/spark-ui/?path=/docs/inputs-switch--docs): A lever switch that lights a bulb. Exports: Switch.
- [Checkbox](https://phoenix-am.github.io/spark-ui/?path=/docs/inputs-checkbox--docs): A checkbox that closes a circuit. Exports: Checkbox.
- [RadioGroup](https://phoenix-am.github.io/spark-ui/?path=/docs/inputs-radiogroup--docs): One live wire at a time. Exports: RadioGroup.
- [Slider](https://phoenix-am.github.io/spark-ui/?path=/docs/inputs-slider--docs): A dimmer, with two-knob ranges. Exports: Slider.
- [Textfield](https://phoenix-am.github.io/spark-ui/?path=/docs/inputs-textfield--docs): A field that charges as you type. Exports: Textfield.
- [Field](https://phoenix-am.github.io/spark-ui/?path=/docs/inputs-field--docs): Label, help text and error wiring for any control. Exports: Field.
- [NumberField](https://phoenix-am.github.io/spark-ui/?path=/docs/inputs-numberfield--docs): Locale-formatted numbers (₹1,00,000, %, units) with steppers. Exports: NumberField.
- [TimePicker](https://phoenix-am.github.io/spark-ui/?path=/docs/inputs-timepicker--docs): Type a time segment by segment or pick from suggestions every N minutes; min/max and blocked slots. Exports: TimePicker.
- [Textarea](https://phoenix-am.github.io/spark-ui/?path=/docs/inputs-textarea--docs): Multi-line text that grows with its content, with a character count. Exports: Textarea.
- [Alert](https://phoenix-am.github.io/spark-ui/?path=/docs/feedback-alert--docs): Info, success, warning and error messages, with actions, dismiss and a banner variant. Exports: Alert.
- [Navigation](https://phoenix-am.github.io/spark-ui/?path=/docs/navigation-breadcrumbs--docs): Breadcrumbs and Pagination. Exports: Breadcrumbs, Pagination.
- [Charts](https://phoenix-am.github.io/spark-ui/?path=/docs/data-charts--docs): Our own SVG charts: Line/Area, Bar (grouped, stacked, horizontal), Donut, Sparkline. Validated colour-blind-safe palette, tooltips, keyboard, data-table view. Exports: LineChart, BarChart, DonutChart, Sparkline.
- [Dropdown](https://phoenix-am.github.io/spark-ui/?path=/docs/inputs-dropdown--docs): Pick one value from a list. Exports: Dropdown.
- [Combobox](https://phoenix-am.github.io/spark-ui/?path=/docs/inputs-combobox--docs): Type to search, then pick. Exports: Combobox.
- [DatePicker](https://phoenix-am.github.io/spark-ui/?path=/docs/inputs-datepicker--docs): DatePicker, DateRangePicker, Calendar and RangeCalendar: typed entry, presets, date rules, locales and calendar systems. Exports: DatePicker, Segment, DateRangePicker, Calendar, RangeCalendar.
- [DataTable](https://phoenix-am.github.io/spark-ui/?path=/docs/data-display-datatable--docs): Sort, search, filter, page and select rows; responsive div grid, no table library. Exports: DataTable.
- [CommandPalette](https://phoenix-am.github.io/spark-ui/?path=/docs/navigation-commandpalette--docs): A ⌘K launcher: search commands and pages, run with the keyboard. Exports: CommandPalette.
- [Menu](https://phoenix-am.github.io/spark-ui/?path=/docs/navigation-menu--docs): Actions behind a button, with submenus. Exports: Menu.
- [Sidebar](https://phoenix-am.github.io/spark-ui/?path=/docs/navigation-sidebar--docs): App navigation: sections, nested groups, collapsed rail, drawer on small screens. Exports: Sidebar.
- [Tabs](https://phoenix-am.github.io/spark-ui/?path=/docs/navigation-tabs--docs): Tabs on one wire; the active tab is lit. Exports: Tabs, TabList, Tab, TabPanel.
- [Accordion](https://phoenix-am.github.io/spark-ui/?path=/docs/navigation-accordion--docs): Sections that power on as they open. Exports: Accordion, AccordionItem.
- [Modal](https://phoenix-am.github.io/spark-ui/?path=/docs/overlays-modal--docs): A dialog that powers on, with focus trapping. Exports: Modal.
- [Drawer](https://phoenix-am.github.io/spark-ui/?path=/docs/overlays-drawer--docs): A panel that slides in from an edge, with focus trapping. Exports: Drawer.
- [Tooltip](https://phoenix-am.github.io/spark-ui/?path=/docs/overlays-tooltip--docs): A hint that flickers on. Exports: Tooltip.
- [Toast](https://phoenix-am.github.io/spark-ui/?path=/docs/feedback-toast--docs): Notifications. Exports: ToastProvider, ToastShowOptions.
- [Card](https://phoenix-am.github.io/spark-ui/?path=/docs/data-display-card--docs): Card, CardHeader, CardFooter and Skeleton. Exports: Card, CardHeader, Skeleton.
- [Avatar](https://phoenix-am.github.io/spark-ui/?path=/docs/data-display-avatar--docs): Avatar and AvatarGroup. Exports: Avatar, AvatarGroup.
- [Indicators](https://phoenix-am.github.io/spark-ui/?path=/docs/feedback-badge--docs): Badge, Progress and Spinner. Exports: Badge, Progress, Spinner.
- [SparkProvider](https://phoenix-am.github.io/spark-ui/?path=/docs/foundations-customization--docs): App-wide default props, slot classes and locale. Exports: SparkProvider.
- [Base components](https://phoenix-am.github.io/spark-ui/?path=/docs/foundations-base-components--docs): ButtonBase, InputBase, Popover, ListBox and Overlay: the building blocks under the other components. Exports: ButtonBase, InputBase, Popover, ListItemContent, ListBox, Overlay.
